prompt: Make an endless runner where a little robot jumps over cactuses and it gets faster over time.
Make a game like Flappy Bird where a little bee flaps through gaps between tall flower stems.
Make a match-3 puzzle game with cute fruit.

Make a top-down action game where a wizard fights waves of slimes and skeletons with four spells: a fireball, a frost nova that slows enemies, a dash, and a healing circle, each with its own cooldown.
Make a platformer where a ninja cat can run, jump, double jump, wall jump, dash and slide through 3 short levels to reach a flag.

Make a small MOBA-style game: you control a hero in one lane against waves of enemy minions and an enemy tower. The hero has a basic attack and three skills (a dash, a stun and an area blast), levels up from kills, and wins by destroying the enemy tower.
